_how_made: made by code: the real function output on the sample report inside scripts/make_phase3_examples.py (the shipped practice model, trained on invented data)
note: These models are logistic: the effect of one change depends on the other inputs, so the single-change numbers do not add up to the total. `interaction` is the part that does not add up.
notice: Hypothetical. Not a prediction of what will happen. PRACTICE MODEL trained on invented data. The number means nothing about a real person.
limits: A small public dataset, not checked on Indian patients and not clinically validated. An estimate for learning, not a diagnosis. A low score does not mean you are well.
